card.name: Links before groups of people or officials
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, by, and, from, or members right before a group of people or institutions, like security forces, police, or trade unions. Mostly in human rights reports and government policy texts.

modes.label: Of/by before security forces
modes.description: The word of or by after members, elements, or abuse, right before a named security body.
modes.example: there were some instances in which elements<< of>> the security forces acted independently.

modes.label: And/from before a stakeholder group
modes.description: The word and or from in a list of social groups, just before the next group such as employees or unions.
modes.example: voluntary organisations, business<< and>> trade unions to reinforce the campaign's messages

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward words like segments and within, meaning parts of a larger group.
